name: NexaLink Smart Home Hub
description: The NexaLink Smart Home Hub connects and controls all your smart devices from a single app. Supports over 200 smart home protocols including Zigbee, Z-Wave, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth. Features a built-in voice assistant, local processing for faster response, and works with Aria, Corvex Home, and Lumen HomeHub.
shortDescription: Central smart home hub supporting 200+ devices with voice assistant and local processing.
